senses.gloss: m. (preced.) manager, administrator, leader of a community, chief.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 28a:9">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לו לדור שאתה פַּרְנָסוֹ</he> woe to the generation whose leader thou art! <cite ref="Arakhin 17a:11">Arakh. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ לפי דורו</he> as the generation, so the leader.

<cite ref="Yoma 22b:19">Yoma 22ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מעמידין פ׳ וכ׳</he> we should appoint chief of a congregation only one behind whom hangs a mass of reptiles (to whose ancestry some blemish is attached), so that, when he becomes overbearing, we can say to him, turn behind thee; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פַּרְנָסִים</he>, <he>פַּרְנָסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 86b:15">Ib. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>שני פ׳ פובים עמדו וכ׳</he> two good leaders have arisen for Israel, Moses and David.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:3">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> top <he>אין מעמידין פ׳ מחות משלשה</he> we must never appoint less than three managers (of charities).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מעמידין שני אחין פ׳</he> two brothers must not be appointed managers of charity.
